scope: Expanded campaign histories for the shared game and web encyclopedia. Local revision; no release or publication.
supersedes: wiki-lore-2026-10-16.json for prose and chronology validation; existing illustration assets are retained

editorial_review.method: Read original dialogue, quest journals and relevant trigger scripts to establish narrative prerequisites. Reviewed prose separately from structural coverage and source fingerprints.

sequence: River and ford to the village
Erfar and Gort at the village assembly
Sentry, White Wolf and Babur’s tools
Redhead, orc cave and Magic Bit

editorial_review.base_journey: Expanded Gipath investigations, Observatory, rebellion, Erfar exposure, expedition captivity, Tka-Rik, Ingos investigation, Lu-a-Jalla, Suslanger escape, At-Zako investigation, identity restoration and final battle in narrative order. Parallel investigations and optional Airy/companion adventures are qualified in the prose.
editorial_review.expansion_journey: Expanded escape and enslavement, Kel, estate and Feiruz, Last Shelter, enlistment, Gipath, Ingos murder investigation and Jigran war. Zara’s caravan outcomes remain conditional.
editorial_review.yam_akara: The water-damaged pass is rejected. Crooked’s confession clears Yam-Akara, whose library research takes place during confinement.

kel.finding: The Rod of Life offers a conditional resurrection after three parts are collected. The completed reunion is represented, without claiming that every playthrough obtains it.
evidence: bz31j three-part check and reunion branch

editorial_review.bounded_profiles: Pig, Master Arkhar, the fortune-teller, Uyka and Khabburu retain short descriptions grounded in their limited conversations. Six expansion locations retain their original world descriptions rather than invented story events.
editorial_review.limitation: Speaker coverage and valid fingerprints do not by themselves prove exhaustive narrative coverage or correct chronology.
